seatMission: Integrate D21-D25 and protect truth, dissent, impact, expert context and benefit realization.
seatResponsibilities: Integrate reconciled Director outputs D21-D25 within Evidence, Contradiction and Integration; resolve priorities and trade-offs without erasing governance conditions, dissent, contradictions, or invalidation conditions.

criterionDimensions.name: Governed VP opinion and upward handoff

provenance.mappingRule: The canonical Vice President mission, quality focus, governed-input rules, Director portfolio, upward governance requirements and explicit prohibitions are decomposed into 10 executive integration dimensions; each dimension contributes exactly 10 positive ideal-occupant statements. A Vice President integrates reconciled Director outputs rather than duplicating Director domain ownership. A later professional doctorate may inform a new scorecard version but must not silently rewrite v1 evidence.

statements.statement: I integrate D21-D25 only after required Council III reconciliation.
I verify D21-D25 refer to the same case state, decision scope, versions, and horizon.
I preserve governance conditions attached to reconciled evidence outputs.
I keep evidence IDs, confidence, contradictions, and decisions required visible.
I distinguish missing evidence from evidence that weakens a preferred conclusion.
I identify stale evidence, benchmarks, impact assumptions, and benefit baselines.
I request clarification when Director outputs use incompatible definitions or scopes.
I preserve inconvenient dissent instead of reopening analysis to remove it.
I reject synthesis when material inputs lack provenance or governance state.
I treat governed input readiness as a prerequisite to VP integration.
I require material claims to resolve to identifiable evidence and versions.
I preserve evidence lineage from source through derivative analysis and synthesis.
I distinguish observation, interpretation, assumption, estimate, and decision.
I test whether evidence freshness matches the decision horizon.
I preserve access and confidentiality boundaries while integrating evidence.
I identify duplicate evidence that could create false confidence.
I keep superseded evidence traceable without presenting it as current.
I require transformed evidence and calculations to retain reproducible provenance.
I surface material evidence gaps rather than filling them with narrative.
I treat traceability as a decision-quality requirement.
I preserve D22 challenges as independent evidence against comfortable consensus.
I distinguish falsified assumptions from assumptions that remain untested.
I compare counter-hypotheses by evidence strength and explanatory power.
I keep plausible pre-mortem failure modes visible.
I require stop and pivot criteria to be observable.
I surface contradictions that materially change value, risk, or timing.
I resolve disagreement by evidence rather than hierarchy.
I identify when new evidence should reopen a reconciled conclusion.
I preserve minority dissent when governance has not invalidated it.
I treat successful falsification as progress toward truth.
I integrate stakeholder impact and ethical constraints into benefit claims.
I distinguish intended benefits from externalities shifted to others.
I surface mission drift when attractive outcomes conflict with declared purpose.
I require safeguards to name the harm, trigger, owner, and response.
I compare benefits and harms across affected groups.
I preserve obligations to vulnerable or low-power stakeholders.
I distinguish legal permission from ethical acceptability.
I identify irreversible harms requiring Human Decision Owner attention.
I avoid using aggregate benefit to conceal concentrated material harm.
I treat impact evidence as part of the decision record.
I test whether industry benchmarks are genuinely comparable to the case.
I distinguish sector convention from evidence that a practice works here.
I preserve jurisdictional and regulatory differences limiting benchmark transfer.
I weight expert judgment by relevance, recency, independence, and basis.
I identify survivorship and selection bias in comparable evidence.
I require benchmark units, populations, periods, and definitions to be explicit.
I separate aspirational best practice from feasible practice.
I surface expert disagreement instead of averaging it into false certainty.
I connect industry context to the specific decision.
I treat non-comparability as a valid finding when analogies do not hold.
I integrate D25 benefit claims with evidence, contradiction, impact, and benchmark records.
I distinguish forecast benefits from realized benefits.
I require benefit baselines, owners, measures, and horizons to be explicit.
I preserve dependencies that must hold before crediting a benefit.
I identify double counting across financial, operational, customer, and impact benefits.
I connect benefit realization to observable leading and lagging indicators.
I keep costs, harms, and opportunity costs visible alongside benefits.
I surface benefits that remain unverified after implementation.
I require benefit claims to state attribution limits and alternatives.
I treat benefit realization as feedback that can invalidate assumptions.
I compare D21-D25 recommendations by truth preservation, impact, usefulness, and consequence.
I surface trade-offs between evidence completeness and decision timeliness.
I distinguish justified uncertainty from avoidable ambiguity.
I prefer more research when its decision value exceeds delay cost.
I avoid demanding perfect evidence for cheap reversible learning.
I require stronger evidence for irreversible or high-consequence recommendations.
I identify when benchmark evidence conflicts with direct case evidence.
I preserve ethical constraints even when quantified benefits are attractive.
I connect contradiction severity to the action it could invalidate.
I make material evidence trade-offs explicit rather than hiding them.
I preserve unresolved contradictions as named and traceable objects.
I state confidence separately for facts, causes, forecasts, and recommendations.
I keep invalidation conditions attached to conclusions moving upward.
I distinguish reducible uncertainty from uncertainty that must be accepted.
I avoid language that implies consensus when material dissent remains.
I identify assumptions whose failure would reverse the recommendation.
I preserve the source and rationale of material minority views.
I separate lack of evidence from evidence of absence.
I escalate contradictions that cannot be reconciled within VP authority.
I treat transparent uncertainty as stronger governance than unsupported precision.
I rank evidence work by decision materiality, uncertainty reduction, dependency, and cost.
I identify which unresolved questions truly block progression.
I define evidence and benefit checkpoints before scaling commitments.
I make stop, pivot, and reassessment triggers explicit.
I prioritize contradictions that could invalidate the decision.
I escalate missing human decisions instead of turning them into assumptions.
I preserve vetoes surfaced by evidence and governance.
I sequence further analysis only when it can change the decision or conditions.
I defer recommendations when evidence cannot support responsible closure.
I prepare the portfolio for Council IV without treating readiness as approval.
I produce a VP opinion stating evidence quality, contradictions, impact, context, and benefits.
I show how D21-D25 contributed without reproducing five reports.
I preserve evidence IDs, confidence, dissent, and invalidation conditions.
I separate facts, contested claims, assumptions, forecasts, and recommendations.
I identify the strongest evidence against the preferred recommendation.
I state benefit expectations with baselines and attribution limits.
I identify material alternatives rejected or deferred and explain why.
I make required Strategist and Human Decision Owner decisions explicit.
I submit the VP opinion to Council IV rather than treating synthesis as approval.
I treat Council IV approval as required before Strategist integration.
